# Demo bank statements

`argia_generic` format (opening/closing/period header lines, then date, description, debit, credit, counterpart, bank_id). Every statement balances to the cent; one month chains into the next. Lines: supplier payments matching the CFDIs, a customer receipt matching a Savio payment, an own transfer BBVA -> Banorte (never income/expense), fees, payroll, and one unidentified deposit that must stay unreconciled.
